[NEWLINE]"Out of a mountain of despair, a stone of hope."[NEWLINE] - Martin Luther King Jr.[NEWLINE]

The Martin Luther King memorial is a large monument constructed in 2011 to honour former Civil Rights activist Martin Luther King junior. It was inspired by a phrase in King's iconic "I have a dream" speech at the Lincoln memorial as part of the March on Washington, one hundred years after Lincoln's Emancipation Proclaimation, in which he decreed all slaves were now free citizens.
